tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background — the canvas everything sits on. Night is the default theme; Paper is the editorial/print variant.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, sheets, the Brownian Brief sections that need separation from ground. Separate with a hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover rows, popovers, the tooltip readout, input fields.

tokens.name: plot
tokens.usage: The plot window: the same colour as the page ground in both themes, so a chart sits on the page instead of in a box. It is separated by a hairline only. Data colours have a Night and a Paper value.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px rules, panel borders, grid lines, table row dividers. Decorative structure only — never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Section rules, axis baselines, control borders (meets 3:1 against ground in both themes when combined with 1px+ weight).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and hero numbers on ground, surface and surface-raised (≥15:1 both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, units, AI narrative body on ground/surface/surface-raised (≥6.2:1 both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Source lines, timestamps, tick labels outside plots on ground/surface/surface-raised (≥4.6:1 both themes). Never for anything the user must act on.

tokens.name: plot-ink
tokens.usage: Labels, values and leader-line annotations INSIDE a plot window (16:1 on plot).

tokens.name: plot-muted
tokens.usage: Tick labels, axis titles and gridline numerals inside a plot window (6.1:1 on plot).

tokens.name: plot-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines, plus-mark crosshairs and wireframe back-faces inside a plot window.

tokens.name: plot-dawn
tokens.usage: The accent inside a plot window: the needle, the 'now' dot, the highlighted band name and the focused line. Use instead of dawn on a plot (paper: 4.9:1 on the light plot).

tokens.name: dawn
tokens.usage: Brand accent — first light. The one highlight per view: the focused series, the 'now' dot, the primary button fill. As text outside plots use dawn-ink.

tokens.name: on-dawn
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a dawn fill (10.5:1).

tokens.name: dawn-ink
tokens.usage: Dawn as TEXT on ground/surface: the italic headline word, live-status labels, 'New' story chips (11.4:1 night, 5.5:1 paper). Use instead of dawn whenever the dawn colour is text outside a plot.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Positive change as TEXT on ground/surface (≥4.8:1 both themes). Always with a + sign or ▲ — teal vs ember differ in lightness only 1.6:1, so hue never carries direction alone.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Negative change as TEXT on ground/surface (≥4.7:1 both themes). Always with a true minus (U+2212) or ▼.

tokens.name: plot-gain
tokens.usage: Positive marks inside a plot window: up-strands, above-baseline area, positive bars.

tokens.name: plot-loss
tokens.usage: Negative marks inside a plot window: drawdown fringe, below-baseline area, negative bars.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. ≥5.4:1 on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: spec-0
tokens.usage: Spectrum ramp, lowest value. The sequential 'elevation' ramp for ridgelines, surfaces and heat. Plot only.

tokens.name: spec-1
tokens.usage: Spectrum ramp step 1.

tokens.name: spec-2
tokens.usage: Spectrum ramp step 2.

tokens.name: spec-3
tokens.usage: Spectrum ramp step 3 (midpoint).

tokens.name: spec-4
tokens.usage: Spectrum ramp step 4.

tokens.name: spec-5
tokens.usage: Spectrum ramp step 5.

tokens.name: spec-6
tokens.usage: Spectrum ramp, highest value. Peaks only — the brightest point in a view should be the highest value in the data.

tokens.name: tide-0
tokens.usage: Tide ramp, lowest. The cool sequential ramp for liquidity, cash and inflow intensity. Plot only.

tokens.name: tide-1
tokens.usage: Tide ramp step 1.

tokens.name: tide-2
tokens.usage: Tide ramp step 2.

tokens.name: tide-3
tokens.usage: Tide ramp step 3.

tokens.name: tide-4
tokens.usage: Tide ramp, highest.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Categorical 1 (tide) — strands and series that must be told apart. Use in order; at most 6 per view; label every one directly.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Categorical 2 (dawn).

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Categorical 3 (ember).

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Categorical 4 (orchid).

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Categorical 5 (sky).

tokens.name: cat-6
tokens.usage: Categorical 6 (bone) — also 'other / unclassified'.

tokens.name: flow-s1
tokens.usage: Flow map, sectors FPIs net sold, warm to cool: red (the largest).

tokens.name: flow-s2
tokens.usage: Flow map source: coral.

tokens.name: flow-s3
tokens.usage: Flow map source: orange.

tokens.name: flow-s4
tokens.usage: Flow map source: amber.

tokens.name: flow-s5
tokens.usage: Flow map source: pale yellow.

tokens.name: flow-s6
tokens.usage: Flow map source: white (on Paper, near-black), the grouped other sectors.

tokens.name: neon-0
tokens.usage: Terrain neon ramp, smallest flows: deep violet. Bars are coloured by size; position gives direction.

tokens.name: neon-1
tokens.usage: Terrain neon ramp: violet.

tokens.name: neon-2
tokens.usage: Terrain neon ramp: magenta.

tokens.name: neon-3
tokens.usage: Terrain neon ramp: red-orange.

tokens.name: neon-4
tokens.usage: Terrain neon ramp: orange.

tokens.name: neon-5
tokens.usage: Terrain neon ramp: yellow.

tokens.name: neon-6
tokens.usage: Terrain neon ramp, largest flows: white on Night, near-black on Paper.

tokens.name: mast-1
tokens.usage: Header bar colour 1 of five; each bar rolls through all five (Night teal, Paper electric azure).

tokens.name: mast-2
tokens.usage: Header bar colour 2 of five; each bar rolls through all five (Night violet, Paper vivid violet).

tokens.name: mast-3
tokens.usage: Header bar colour 3 of five; each bar rolls through all five (Night rose, Paper hot pink).

tokens.name: mast-4
tokens.usage: Header bar colour 4 of five; each bar rolls through all five (Night orange, Paper neon orange).

tokens.name: mast-5
tokens.usage: Header bar colour 5 of five; each bar rolls through all five (Night gold, Paper neon green).

tokens.name: mast-ink-1
tokens.usage: Text on header bar colour 1; it changes with the bar so it reads on every colour.

tokens.name: mast-ink-2
tokens.usage: Text on header bar colour 2; it changes with the bar so it reads on every colour.

tokens.name: mast-ink-3
tokens.usage: Text on header bar colour 3; it changes with the bar so it reads on every colour.

tokens.name: mast-ink-4
tokens.usage: Text on header bar colour 4; it changes with the bar so it reads on every colour.

tokens.name: mast-ink-5
tokens.usage: Text on header bar colour 5; it changes with the bar so it reads on every colour.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero number — one per screen, the first thing read in the morning. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Screen titles and section heroes. Pair with one serif-italic word.

styles.name: display-serif
styles.usage: The ONE italic word inside a display line ("Markets, *overnight*"). Never a full sentence, never body.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headlines in the Brownian Brief.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles, chart titles, list item names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: FIIs sold ₹2,140 Cr in cash; DIIs absorbed most of it.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: Brief prepared 07:52 IST · sessions of Thu 12 Nov
styles.usage: The context line UNDER a heading (never a label above it). ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Sentence-case names for KPI values, table headers and legend keys. ink-muted. Not for text above headings.

styles.name: num-l
styles.usage: Deltas beside the hero number, KPI tile values.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Every number in tables, tooltips and readouts. Right-aligned, tabular.

styles.name: tick
styles.usage: Axis ticks, annotation labels, leader-line callouts inside plots. Never below 10px.

styles.name: source
styles.usage: The source line under every figure. Uppercase. ink-faint.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Source tags [S#] (brief) and [W#] (web) after every figure. A button that opens the source.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a number and its unit or sign glyph.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label-to-value gaps, chip padding, tick-to-axis offset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on mobile, gutter between KPI tiles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; the plus-mark crosshair pitch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a section headline and its figure.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side margins on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between Brief sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Above the hero number; the 'breath' before the first figure.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Plot windows and every chart mark. Data is never rounded.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Status chips, ticker tags, legend keys.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented controls, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and sheets that are not plots.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and filter pills.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Unit strands in Strand Flow, wireframe lines, ridgeline contour lines.

tokens.name: stroke-thin
tokens.usage: Hairlines, axes, gridlines, leader lines.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: The focused series, sparklines, the 'now' marker.

tokens.name: opacity-strand
tokens.usage: Default opacity of a unit strand; overlaps build density honestly.

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: Everything not in focus while one series or flow is hovered or selected.
